mapper.select: SELECT bs.BOARD_SHARE_ID, bs.BOARD_ID, bs.USERNAME, bs.PERMISSION, bs.CREATED_AT, bs.CREATED_BY, b.BOARD_NAME, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, u.USERNAME AS LOGIN_ID, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TB_BOARD_SHARE bs INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON bs.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON bs.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE bs.BOARD_SHARE_ID = #{boardShareId}

SELECT bs.BOARD_SHARE_ID, bs.BOARD_ID, bs.USERNAME, bs.PERMISSION, bs.CREATED_AT, bs.CREATED_BY, b.BOARD_NAME, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, u.USERNAME AS LOGIN_ID, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TB_BOARD_SHARE bs INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON bs.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON bs.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE bs.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND bs.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY u.NAME

SELECT bs.BOARD_SHARE_ID, bs.BOARD_ID, bs.USERNAME, bs.PERMISSION, bs.CREATED_AT, bs.CREATED_BY, b.BOARD_NAME, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, u.USERNAME AS LOGIN_ID, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TB_BOARD_SHARE bs INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON bs.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON bs.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE bs.USERNAME = #{username} AND bs.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND b.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY b.BOARD_NAME

SELECT bs.BOARD_SHARE_ID, bs.BOARD_ID, bs.USERNAME, bs.PERMISSION, bs.CREATED_AT, bs.CREATED_BY, b.BOARD_NAME, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, u.USERNAME AS LOGIN_ID, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TB_BOARD_SHARE bs INNER JOIN TB_BOARD b ON bs.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID INNER JOIN TB_USER u ON bs.USERNAME = u.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT d ON u.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE bs.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND bs.USERNAME = #{username} AND bs.DELETED_AT IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BOARD_SHARE WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BOARD_SHARE ( BOARD_ID, USERNAME, PERMISSION, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{username}, #{permission}, #{createdBy} )
